evals.name: paper-newsletter
evals.prompt:
You are the session "Newsletter" of a small online shop (project folder ./newsletter). Four items are open that the owner has to decide. The numbers were measured in this session or read from invoices:
1. Send every 2 weeks instead of monthly. Open rate monthly 41 %, in the 2 test sends at the 2-week rhythm 38 % and 40 %. Proposal: yes.
2. Recipe section: every issue gets a recipe that uses one of our products. Effort per issue about 2 hours. Proposal: yes.
3. Discount code in every issue (10 %). Against: people start waiting for discounts. Proposal: no.
4. Move to a hosted mail service: costs 39 USD a month at 5,000 contacts, the own server goes away. Proposal: later.
The owner writes: "as a newspaper".
evals.expected_output: content.json with 4 items and block paper (2 or 3 editions), build.py --check OK, index.html starting with paper, short message to the user that the page is open and how to paste the answers back.

evals.name: budget-app-ideas
evals.prompt:
You are the session "App ideas". The user collected five ideas for their task app, you estimated the effort (1 build night = about three hours of work with an agent):
- Keyboard shortcut for the inbox: 1 build night, proposal yes
- Light and dark theme: 2 build nights, proposal later
- Group tasks by project: 3 build nights, proposal yes
- Weekly report of how long tasks waited: 2 build nights, proposal yes
- Own tablet app: 8 build nights, proposal no
Plus one choice: should search look only at titles or also at notes? Proposal: also notes.
The user says: "give me that as a budget game, I have about 4 evenings this week".
evals.expected_output: content.json with 6 items (5 with cost, 1 choice with options), unit build night, block budget with start 4, build.py --check OK, index.html starting with budget, message to the user.
